raw.details:
About the Challenge:

Malla Reddy Talentio Online Coding Challenge 2026 is an online coding competition designed to help participants improve their programming, problem-solving, logical thinking, and coding skills through practical programming challenges.

Eligibility:

  • College students, freshers, and coding enthusiasts can participate.
  • Participants should have basic programming knowledge.
  • The challenge is open for individual participation.
  • Participants should have access to a computer and a stable internet connection.

Challenge Format:

  • The challenge will be conducted completely online.
  • Participants will be provided with multiple programming problems.
  • Questions may include different difficulty levels.
  • Participants need to write and submit their solutions online.
  • Solutions will be automatically evaluated using predefined test cases.

Rules:

  • Each participant must submit their own solutions.
  • Participants should not use unfair means or plagiarize solutions from other participants.
  • Participants must complete the challenges within the specified contest duration.
  • Participants should carefully read the problem statement, input format, output format, and constraints before submitting.
  • Multiple submissions may be allowed depending on the challenge platform.
  • Any form of malpractice or plagiarism may lead to disqualification.

Evaluation:

Solutions will be evaluated using automated test cases.

Participants will be assessed based on:

  • Correctness of the solution
  • Number of test cases passed
  • Problem-solving ability
  • Algorithmic thinking
  • Overall coding performance

How to Participate:

  • Register for the challenge on Unstop.
  • Access the coding challenge through the provided challenge link.
  • Read the problem statements carefully.
  • Write and test your code.
  • Submit your solutions before the contest ends.
  • The final performance will be determined based on the evaluation criteria.

Objective:

The objective of this challenge is to provide participants with practical coding experience and encourage them to improve their programming, problem-solving, and competitive coding skills.
